description: This bar chart, titled "NDCG@10", illustrates the NDCG@10 scores for three distinct methods: "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", which are plotted along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 score, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 in increments of 0.05, with a linear scale. The bar labeled "- critiquing" is colored orange and has a height corresponding to a value of approximately 0.21. The bar labeled "- scoring" is colored blue and is the shortest, with a height of approximately 0.07. The bar labeled "- ranking" is also blue and has a height of approximately 0.12. The chart includes a fourth, unlabeled bar on the far left, colored gray, which is not associated with any of the three methods shown. The bars are arranged in a single group along the horizontal axis, with no explicit grouping or stacking, and are not sorted in any particular order. The chart does not include a legend, and no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color and height.
